name: Grand Regent Reina
title: Grand Regent Reina
heroSub: Wisteria Violet Cubic Zirconia, sister of Nightshade Violet Diamond and Grand Regent Antton.
facts: Nightshade Violet Diamond, Grand Regent Antton
known: Reina is one of Nightshade Violet Diamond's two Cubic Zirconias, alongside Grand Regent Antton. Much of Court Nightshade's business runs through her.
She wears a visor that flashes text when she has something to add, calls her throne her Couch, and is rarely seen without a can of Highly Volatile Green Liquid Energy.
She and Bi-Colored Kandy Diamond are tinkering buddies.
Her full page goes up when her updated submission is done.
